title: Google releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen, claims 2.5× speedup and unified pricing
summary: Google released Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a model aimed at fast execution for everyday coding and agent workflows, according to a Telegram brief; it is described as available to developers, enterprises, and general users. The brief lists unified pricing of $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens. It also claims a 2.5× speedup over Gemini 3.8 Flash, raising Terminal-Bench 4.1 from 18.2% to 57%, and says the default tier beats Argon on the Artificial Analysis index. These figures come from the release brief and have not been independently verified in the supplied material.
